solution:
The correct answer is __**IV**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Magnesium**:

 
 
• The symbol for **Magnesium is Mg.**
 
• So, A matches with iv.
 
 
 
• **Boron:**
 
 
• The symbol for **Boron is B.**
 
• So, B matches with ii.
 
 
 
• **Manganese:**
 
 
• The symbol for **Manganese is Mn**.
 
• So, C matches with i.
 
 
 
• **Barium:**
 
 
• The symbol for **Barium is Ba**.
 
• So, D matches with iii.
